campaignQualification: Overlapping groups. Desktop and Pixel 7 Chromium emulation; no physical device or owner acceptance. Runtime source frozen per campaign. Historical evidence kept isolated. GPU program split was followed by targeted GPU pixel/native and held checks; Canvas adapter unchanged. Final JSX-only guard hides on-map sizing in read-only inspection; four actual cut pixel/read-only/fallback cases passed afterward. Final accounting-only correction keeps opposing GPU texture allocation bytes after disabling cut views; build/typecheck passed.

heldPainting.qualification: 900 injected moves over 15 seconds each; native dispatch may coalesce. Terrain pixel observations at 100 ms cadence. Release coherent timing is separate from per-input latency. Every run asserts both full-bank hashes across Undo/Redo and retains the opposite bank and authored hole.

developmentCorrections: Initial cut shader rejected an undeclared interval sentinel and reserved identifier; fixed and actual GPU/Canvas checks passed.
Initial post-shader workflow expected removal on saved Undo, but the correct prior journal entry was a cap relocation. Corrected the oracle; no history implementation changed.

Native worker rejection could arrive before the next render pump; cancellation now keeps its actual protected-ground reason. Four prior pixel cases failed only this message check, then all eight final pixel/native cases passed.
Initial Canvas held setup clicked before a coherent picker frame; the existing stale-view guard correctly refused it. Added the missing helper wait, then all eight held cases passed.
Kept the accepted ordinary GPU terrain path separate from the larger cut program, prepared on first supported cut view.

Final inspection check found hole-size buttons in read-only cavity navigation. Hid them in inspection; the same desktop Canvas case changed from red to green and all four final GPU/Canvas desktop/mobile pixel cases passed.
